heading: We diagnose, treat and revive.
intro: From a quick repot to full pest treatment, every plant is properly assessed and goes home with its own care card.
dropOff: Book a 15 minute slot to bring your plant to the thrive Houseplant Hospital. We'll check your plants on arrival and give an assessment of what they need to thrive.
pickUp: We collect from your doorstep, take your plant to the Houseplant Hospital for a full assessment and treatment, then return it once it's ready. BS1 to BS9. Free collection for 3 or more plants, or £8 for 1 or 2.

treatments.name: Health check and diagnosis
treatments.description: A proper look at leaves, roots and soil, and a plan.

treatments.name: Repotting
treatments.description: Fresh mix, a root tidy, and a pre-loved pot if it needs one.

treatments.name: Pest treatment
treatments.description: Mealybugs, spider mites, fungus gnats, scale and thrips.

treatments.name: Full rescue
treatments.description: Root rot, overwatering and serious decline.

treatments.name: Prune and propagate
treatments.description: Tame an out of control plant, and save cuttings to grow on.

treatmentsNote: [PLACEHOLDER] Prices to be confirmed by Mandie.

careCard.light: Bright, indirect. Not in a south window.
careCard.water: When the top 3cm of soil is dry.
careCard.treated: Root rot. Trimmed and repotted into chunky aroid mix.

faqs.question: How long will my plant stay at the hospital?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] It depends on the treatment. A repot can be the same week; a pest treatment or full rescue needs longer so we can check it's really working. We'll always give you an estimate at drop-off.

faqs.question: What if my plant can't be saved?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] We'll be honest with you. Often we can still take healthy cuttings and propagate them, so a piece of your plant lives on.

faqs.question: Do you treat orchids and succulents?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] Yes. Orchids struggling after the summer heat are a regular visitor, and succulents and cacti are welcome too.

faqs.question: Where is the Houseplant Hospital?
faqs.answer: In Bristol. You'll get the full address when you book your drop-off slot.
